result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical broken elements. However, there is a minor layout issue where the last restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza image) is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport, suggesting incomplete scrolling or insufficient bottom padding.
